evidence.summary: FOI-supported school-leaver selection structure uses 60% academic performance and 40% UCAT. ApplySmart Home guidance produces prediction tiers only because Dundee's exact academic scoring conversion and current applicant-pool UCAT decile boundaries are not published. The Scottish Higher proxy treats a confirmed qualifying Dundee Standard or Contextual Higher route as satisfying the Higher academic-strength component; it does not claim Dundee awards identical official academic scores to all eligible applicants. International behaviour remains separately configured.

score_model.label: Dundee ApplySmart pre-interview guidance model
score_model.basis: School-leaver weighting is FOI-supported at 60% academic and 40% UCAT. Home guidance uses an internal ApplySmart 0-100 guidance index for classification only because Dundee's exact academic scoring conversion and annual applicant-pool UCAT decile boundaries are not public; International scoring remains separately evidenced. The index is not Dundee's official score.

presentation.trust_statement: Dundee uses academic performance and UCAT in pre-interview ranking. ApplySmart cannot reproduce Dundee's exact internal score because the complete academic scoring table and current Dundee applicant-pool UCAT decile boundaries are not published. The internal guidance index is hidden from Result Cards and is not Dundee's official score.
presentation.selection_summary: Dundee ranks school-leaver applicants before interview using academic performance and UCAT. The school-leaver weighting is 60% academic and 40% UCAT; this result is an ApplySmart-derived prediction tier, not a Dundee cut-off or official ranking score.

scottish_academic.assumption_note: Dundee's exact Scottish academic scoring conversion is unpublished. ApplySmart conservatively treats a confirmed qualifying Dundee Standard or Contextual Higher route as satisfying the Higher academic-strength component, while National 5 strength may provide the existing estimated differentiation. This does not claim Dundee awards identical official academic scores to all eligible Higher profiles.
